features.title: Capture and confirm printed source
features.user_visible_behavior: Capture or select up to two photos for one lesson, OCR them locally and sequentially, and confirm editable extracted text beside each image.
verification: Process fresh English/Filipino printed-page photos locally in the desktop web demo; verify native OCR separately during later phone acceptance.
Retain photos, raw OCR, corrected text, and page references separately; require explicit confirmation.
Exercise poor/empty OCR recovery and visible rejection or narrowing of oversized input.
Edit confirmed source and verify older generated items, answers, and quiz progress are invalidated.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Confirm extracted source before deriving study material. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass. Local OCR remains required; browser and native implementations need separate adapters and evidence.

features.title: Generate a source-linked reviewer
features.user_visible_behavior: Generate and save approximately five short study items in the selected English or Filipino response language, with source-page references and verbatim quotations.
verification: Generate items from confirmed corrected text and inspect answer meaning against visible source evidence in both response languages.
Validate output structure, page IDs, text bounds, and exact quotations; reject malformed or unsupported output.
Allow at most one bounded retry and verify failed generation preserves previously completed saved work.
Use the live configured cloud adapter for acceptance; disclose remote text transfer and show connection/quota errors without losing confirmed source.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Visible source evidence makes generated study material inspectable; quotation matching alone does not prove answer correctness. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.

features.title: Practice with cards and a scored quiz
features.user_visible_behavior: Flip cards and complete three multiple-choice questions reused from the study items, with deterministic scoring and source-backed feedback after wrong answers.
verification: Flip the generated cards and answer all three quiz questions.
Check correct and incorrect selections using stable choice IDs; inspect distractors for ambiguity.
After an incorrect selection, show the correct answer, supporting source, and a short explanation.
If explanation generation fails, retain the correct answer and source; verify successfully saved quiz progress survives reopening.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Reuse facts across study modes and deterministically score explicit choices. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.

features.title: Ask about the lesson
features.user_visible_behavior: Ask short lesson-grounded questions in English or Filipino, view validated supporting evidence, and receive a clear response when an answer is absent.
verification: Ask supported and absent-answer questions in English and Filipino through the live cloud service on desktop and inspect meaning; phone verification occurs later.
Verify returned page references and quotations against the current confirmed source.
Reject invalid evidence and exercise understandable busy, failure, and retry states.
Verify source content is treated as untrusted lesson data and completed work remains available during failures.
When offline, show that new answers require internet and keep saved study material available.
features.notes: Domain pattern: Bounded lesson help with visible evidence lets students inspect generated answers. | Separate OpenSpec change will be proposed after dependencies pass.

features.title: Reopen saved study offline
features.user_visible_behavior: Restore one saved lesson, cards and quiz progress after cold offline reopening; study and score saved questions without internet. Cloud generation and new chat answers require a connection.
verification: Close the production app and reopen with internet disconnected; verify the web shell is available rather than relying on an already-loaded tab.
Verify saved photos, raw/corrected source, generated items and quiz progress restore; flip cards and deterministically score saved quiz choices offline.
Verify cloud generation/new chat visibly require internet without erasing saved work. Offline fresh-photo OCR and local generation are outside current acceptance.
Simulate failed storage writes and confirm no false saved label; verify recovery and source-revision invalidation.
features.notes: Scope revised on 2026-10-10: saved study offline; new AI content uses cloud. Native reopening remains a later device check. Separate OpenSpec change after dependencies pass.
